findings.summary: the CSP was declared but never reached the document, because a file:// response carries no headers
the mute proof was a test that passes with setMuted implemented as a no-op
four criteria named Playwright and no Playwright test existed
the spec said Stop freezes the position; the engine rewinds, by design
output:device changed direction and output:restore was added without the spec following
the brief still described elapsed from the tick inside the beat
the chosen device was never persisted: main validated against a list it can never have
two play presses before the engine resolved would build two engines
main was told the set was playing even when the engine threw
a second gainForDigit in the store, dead in production, was the one the safety test guarded
the only orange control turned grey the moment music started, with its reason visible to nobody
dismissing a strip while playing dropped focus to the body, because the play button was disabled
the output bar had no accessible name and neither bar was a landmark
the README still said there was nothing to hear
the brief promised a chip ticking with the music that the screen never asked for
the architecture channel list, the stack test row and the shot command row were stale
single-key shortcuts have no way to be turned off or remapped, which SC 2.1.4 requires
the restored output device never reached the engine, because it is applied before the engine exists
the e2e suite did not build first, so it proved whatever bundle was on disk
the navigation refusal test passed with the guard removed, because about:blank and an unresolvable host both leave the URL unchanged
the seven e2e tests shared one profile directory and two of them deleted it
the reentrancy guard, the modifier guard, the load timeout, the device revert and the play failure had no test
a stubbed navigator survived into every later test in the file
two assertions read through another package's class names or repeated the test above them
the device channel was said to answer the value stored before the write; keep reassigns preferences, and a test already asserts the answer
the fresh screenshots showed the volume at silent, because the shot tool inherited the machine's stored preferences
a load that never arrives offers no in-app retry, only reopening the app
the mute proof read a getter symmetric with its setter, so a node built with the wrong units was invisible; the mute is metered now
the built-markup CSP test returned early when out/ was absent, which is every path that runs it; the policy is asserted on the live document in e2e
the wireframe in the design brief still named header.shell-deck and footer.shell-output
the review state file did not describe the review it is evidence of
the keyboard e2e never pressed ArrowDown
the device revert on failure was dead code, because the picker only moves after the sink change succeeds
the header half of the policy had no coverage at all
Transport accepts state playing without onPause when stopOnly is unset, and the main button then replays
the shot tool left its temporary profile and a live app behind when a step threw
